answer: Each identity must register one distinct beehive at a verified apiary, its hive painted umber and tagged at the vertex of its lid with a lantern-shaped seal photographed monthly by an inspector who checks live bee activity and a unique queen-mark number. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 hives at $280 each ($280,000), $35 monthly inspection per hive, and real beekeeping labour, with a 5-coin bond lost per dead, shared or moved hive.
